description: Planning a trip? Add Priceline to search for hotels right in your conversation. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, when, and what matters — close to downtown, near the beach, budget-friendly — and get results on an interactive map with live Priceline deals. Easily compare options, then book on Priceline or continue your conversation with Penny, Priceline's AI travel agent.
